nodes.title: Help❓
widgets_values:
🔹 This group lets you inpaint with a cropped/full context area.
🔹 Select 'true' to crop the context area (✂️) or 'false' to use the full image (🌎).
🔹 Select 'true' to draw a context mask (🗺️) to grow the context area (🧿).
🔹 Prompt (3️⃣) should focus on the context area (🧿) ie. what the model sees.
🔹 Run to populate the mask nodes (4️⃣), they can stop execution if no mask.
🔹 An inpainting model (1️⃣) is recommended for best results.

nodes.title: Help❓
widgets_values:
🔹 This group lets you remove, composite, crop, and outpaint the background.
🔹 Select 'true' to replace (🧭), which enables remove (👤) and composite (🍔).
🔹 Select 'false to reframe (🖼️), which enables crop (✂️) and outpaint (🚧).
🔹 When compositing (🍔), select 'true' to generate (🌳) or 'false' to load (📤) an image.
🔹 When outpainting (🚧), the image edges are extended to add latent data for sampling.
🔹 An inpainting model (1️⃣) is recommended for outpainting (🚧).

nodes.title: Help❓
widgets_values:
🔹 This group stores previous generations in up to 3 memory slots (💡).
🔹 You must run the workflow with the loop group (♾️) active to display the images.
🔹 The temporary images are deleted when you close the session.
🔹 Select up to 1 image (♻️) to reuse it as the input for any group.

nodes.title: Help❓
widgets_values:
🔹 This group lets you create a new image with optional controlnet/ipadapter.
🔹 Select 'true' for Txt2Img (✍️) or 'false' for Img2Img (🧬).
🔹 Select 'true' to upscale (⚖️) with a model before encoding for I2I (🧬).
🔹 The size (2️⃣) of the latent can be set for T2I (✍️) or resized for I2I (🧬).
🔹 ControlNet and IPAdapter only work with stable diffusion models.

🔹 Select 'true' for ControlNet (🎯) or 'false' to disable it.
🔹 Select 'true' to preprocess (🔮) the loaded image (1️⃣) with the selected preprocessor.
🔹 The ControlNet (2️⃣) must match the preprocessor (🔮) and base model (sd1.5/sdxl).

🔹 Select 'true' for IPAdapter (🦜) or 'false' to disable it.
🔹 Load up to 6 images to create an image batch, or mute them to use fewer.
🔹 The first image in the batch will resize the others to its resolution.

nodes.title: Help❓
widgets_values:
🔹 This group lets you refine features by automating the masking process.
🔹 Select 'true' for face swap (🥸) or 'false' for auto detailer (🧙).
🔹 Select 'true' to enable swapping (🎭) or 'false' to restore face only.
🔹 Select 'true' to swap 1 face (👤) or 'false' to swap 2 faces (👥).
🔹 Face swap (🥸) uses a detection model to identify faces, crops them with a bounding box, 
switches the faces with a swap model, and masks them with a segmentation model.
🔹 Auto detailer (🧙) uses a detection model to identify features (faces, hands...), 
crops them with a bounding box, upscales them, masks them with a segmentation model, 
inpaints them, scales them back down, and stitches them back over the original image.

nodes.title: START HERE 🔔
widgets_values:
OVERVIEW:
🔹 There are 11 core functions across 5 color-coded groups.
🔹 The help nodes (❓) go into detail about each group's functionality.
🔹 Each group is a self-contained workflow and numbered (1️⃣,2️⃣,3️⃣) for readability.
🔹 Group toggles (🌐) in the top-right let you deactivate any group.
🔹 The image from the first active group is sent to the next active group, left-to-right.
🔹 If any group is used alone, load image (0️⃣) is used as the input.
🔹 Right-click on the left side of the compare node (👁️) to save the output from any group.
🔹 Activate up to 3 memory groups (💡) to save the last output to the loop group (♾️).
🔹 Activate the loop group (♾️) to use a saved image as the input for any other group.
🔹 The switches in the top-left let you toggle the group function and model settings.
🔹 The model loader (1️⃣) can load checkpoints and single/dual-clip models.
🔹 Select 'true' for a checkpoint (🎁) or 'false' for a custom loader (🔌).
🔹 Select 'true' for a dual-clip loader (🖇️) or 'false' for a single-clip loader (📎).
🔹 Select 'true' for flux guidance (👣) or 'false' to disable (causes error on some models).
🔹 Bookmarks (🔖) use shortcuts (0-6) to jump to each group (maximize to adjust zoom).
🔹 Missing nodes can be downloaded from the dependencies below or the Manager.
🔹 Missing models can be downloaded from the resources below or the Manager.

ERRORS:
🪳 No such file or directory
🔧 Reference image was deleted/moved, select a different image in the given node.
🪳 Allocation on device
🔧 Out of vram. Run again, Comfy caches previous outputs and unloads models.
🪳 Expected input to have x channels, but got y channels instead
🔧 Model compatibility, only use models compatible with each other.
🪳 Black/noisy output
🔧 Set clip skip to -2.

🔹 This group does model or tiled upscaling, the 'model' is used for both.
🔹 Select 'true' to use a model (⚡) or 'false' to use use tiles (🧩).
🔹 Select 'true' to save (💾) the output or 'false' to disable saving.
🔹 The 'file prefix' lets you add a prefix to the title of the saved image.
🔹 The final downscale (8️⃣) lets you resize before saving.
